response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a strong track record across web, mobile, and systems projects, but his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and product engineering rather than modern C++ or Rust systems work. His C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint and a personal audio project, with no evidence of distributed systems, routing/tiling pipelines, or navigation-domain work, making him a poor match for this C++/Rust-centric routing infrastructure role.
strengths: Broad, adaptable engineering background spanning many languages and domains
Relevant geospatial/GIS domain exposure via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong communicator with teaching, workshop, and open-source leadership experience
concerns: Minimal recent hands-on C++ experience (last significant use was 2014-2015)
No listed Rust experience at all
No demonstrated background in distributed systems, fault tolerance, or navigation/routing pipelines

key_factors.factor: Lack of current C++/Rust systems experience
No routing/navigation or distributed-systems pipeline experience
Some geospatial domain familiarity from side projects
